newsitem.title: USA: NIMO shuts Nine Mile Pt 1 nuclear unit.
newsitem.headline: NIMO shuts Nine Mile Pt 1 nuclear unit.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp said Friday it has fully shut its 610 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point 1 nuclear power plant for repairs to a valve in the unit's containment system.
"We expect it to be back early next week," said company spokesman Bob Burtch, when asked how long the unit would likely be down.
He said engineers had initially hoped to keep operating the unit at reduced capacity, but this was not possible and it was taken fully off line at 0532 EDT.
Burtch said NIMO currently has a surplus of power and would not need to go to the open market to secure spot supplies.
Nine Mile Point 1 is in Scriba, N.Y.

The adjoining 1,137 MW Nine Mile Point 2 nuclear power unit, also operated by NIMO, continued to operate at 95 percent of capacity while a moisture separator reheater was out of service, the NRC said.
